comment: Read from src/Synth.cpp at the tag release/v2.1.1, commit f622217, which is the installed 2.1.1, alongside the README. The module is switched off entirely when the V/Oct input has no cable: Synth.cpp:912 takes the channel count from that jack alone and Synth.cpp:1300 writes 0V to both audio outputs and returns. The README's caveats are the other thing a new user needs: with no modulations assigned nothing is heard, because V/Oct reaches the oscillators only through an assignment and the amp is opened only by one. Ranges are left out of most lines on purpose: the modulatable parameters are configured through one helper (Synth.cpp:880) whose bounds change with the destination, and quoting a figure for the wrong one would be worse than quoting none. The assign buttons carry a description listing their destinations, which is what Rack shows on hover. The five Individual modulation outputs are polyphonic while the two audio outputs are not.
